Run the following root shell commands cleanly:

# emerge --sync
# emerge -a -uvDU @world --keep-going=y
# perl-cleaner --all
# emerge -a --depclean

Also review this configuration file comment block:

# This is the raw git repository and it lacks metadata.
# We do not recommend using it unless you are an advanced user!
